summary_1line: Janamejaya requests the story; Vaisampayana begins recounting the Kuru–Pandava conflict, including early plots against the Pandavas and their escape from the lac house.

image_candidates.scene_text: Duryodhana secretly binds the sleeping Bhima on the bank of the Ganges and casts him into the dark river at night.
The lacquer palace erupts in flames as the Pandavas escape through a hidden underground tunnel into the night.
Bhima wrestles and kills the man-eating Rakshasa Vaka before the terrified townspeople of Ekachakra.
